deadline.value: Priority deadline is February 1, 2027 for Fall 2027 entry; the international final deadline is June 1, 2027.

app_fee.value: The PhD in Mathematics application fee is $80, non-refundable.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional for this PhD; applicants are not required to submit them.
gre_general.quote: you can optionally submit GRE scores (general and/or subject)

gre_subject.value: A Mathematics subject GRE is optional; applicants may submit it if they think it helps.
gre_subject.quote: you can optionally submit GRE scores (general and/or subject)

supervisor.value: The page says students choose a research advisor later in the program; it does not state an admissions rule.

funding.value: CGU says most students receive fellowship funding; fellowships are awarded on merit.
funding.quote: 87% of students receive some form of fellowship funding.

entry_route.value: Applicants submit proof of a completed bachelor's degree; no master's requirement is stated.
entry_route.quote: For undergraduate coursework, applicants are required to submit proof of a completed bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited college or university.

notes: The Institute of Mathematical Sciences also runs a PhD in Computational Science (saved under datasci) and a joint PhD in Engineering & Computational Mathematics with California State University Long Beach. The joint PhD requires GRE or GMAT scores and separate CGU and CSULB applications with both fees; its CGU priority date is February 1, 2027.
